Name: Playable Piano - Fully Playable Instrument
Author: BrianVR1
Description:
[b][size=4]Playable Piano - Fully Playable Musical Instrument[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9ZoBbIl.png[/img]

[/b][list]
[*][b]Interactive Gameplay:[/b] Simply walk up to any furniture item named [i][b]"Piano" and sit down (Right click)[/b][/i]. The game will automatically transition into [i][b]"Piano Mode"[/b][/i], muting background music so you can focus on your performance ! [i][b]If you want to exit the piano mode press [ESC].[/b][/i]
‎[*][b]Key Range:[/b] Supports 61 keys (36 white keys and 25 black keys - spanning from C2 to C7).
‎[img]https://i.ibb.co/8nL7cRd2/Piano-Layout.png[/img][*][b]Dynamic UI:[/b] Toggle the music sheets on and off with a single click.
[*][b]Furniture: [/b]Usable with any Piano furniture. [b][color=#ffd966]Grand Piano now available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43743]here[/url][/color][/b]﻿
[*][b]Multiplayer Support:[/b] Your performance isn't just for you ! ;) Other players on the server will hear the notes you play in real-time !!
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/wmfvAew.png[/img]

Includes an in-game music book.

[b]Custom Songs:[/b] Load your own sheet music or lyrics via a [i].txt[/i] files in the assets folder.

[i]Music sheets need to have a Title (Title=[MusicName]) and the text below with a space separating from the title.

[/i][i]Press [F5] to refresh/live update songs in your folder.
[/i][i]
[/i][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/AdzMZaW.gif[/img]
[i]!!! LONG MUSIC SHEETS WONT FIT YET !!! (I'm working on this !)[/i][/i][list]
[list]
[/list] [/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/rdOKG7K.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Right Click on a Piano to sit down and start to play. Press [ESC] to leave the piano.
[*]‎On-screen key labels help you learn the layout (Press Shift for sharps/flats).
[*]You can also visit this website who have the same layout : https://virtualpiano.net/music-sheets/
[*][asbg] = Play notes together simultaneously
[*][ac] - [ge] = Silence between notes
[*][pf]-[fe] = Play notes one after the other quickly
[/list]
 
[b][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/jpa3VmN.png[/img] [/size]
 
[/b]I'm actually working on other type of features :
 
[list]
[*]Different piano layout/keybinds (downloadable as a separate add-on)
[*]Multiple piano sounds (as synthetiser = guitar sounds, violin, harp, etc..)
[*]Polishing the music sheet book
‎ ‎ [/list][b][size=4]I hope you'll enjoy it !! Don't hesitate to tell me if there's issues :D[/size][/b]
